description: Search real charity stories a brand could fund as a cause-marketing campaign. Matches the query against titles, summaries, charities, causes and places, and returns the best matches with a link to each story page.

cause.description: Only stories for this cause, e.g. "Health". Use list_causes for the values.

limit.description: How many stories to return (default 10, at most 25).

location.description: Only stories in this place, e.g. "Manchester".

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "children Christmas" or "mental health".

name: find_campaign_stories
title: Find campaign stories
